PM Modi Inaugurates Nitish Setu :pradhanmantri narendr modi ne bihar daure ke dauran nitish setu ka udghatan kar diya. vaishali men aayojit karyakram men mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri bhi maujud rahe. nitish setu ke shuru hone se bihar ke vikas aur kanektiviti ko naee majbuti milne ki ummid hai.
Aakhir nitish setu bihar ke lie kitna mahatvapurn hai? udghatan ke dauran kya kuchh khas raha? dekhie is riport men puri jankari.
